result.summary: The page is mostly coherent, but there are several visual/content defects: a nonsensical "-0%" discount badge, inconsistent favorite-button styling, a truncated restaurant name without ellipsis in the carousel, and the second popular card is clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible info.

issues.description: The second card in "Popular right now" shows a promotional badge reading "-0%", which conveys no discount and looks like a data/formatting bug.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the value is 0, or render the actual percentage (e.g. "-20%").

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circle with a dark outline heart, while the second uses a dark/transparent circle with a white heart, reducing recognizability and contrast against the light pizza image.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button treatment (same background, icon color, and size) across all cards, with a scrim if needed for contrast.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" carousel, the third item's title "Trattoria Piccol" is hard-cut at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card image itself is sliced, making it ambiguous whether content is scrollable or broken.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis and use consistent peek spacing/padding so partially visible cards look intentionally offscreen.

issues.description: The category chip row (All / Pizza / Sushi / Burgers / Healthy / …) is clipped at the right edge with a partially rendered chip and no scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient mask or arrow affordance at the right edge and consistent trailing padding for the horizontal chip scroller.

issues.description: The second "Popular right now" card is cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only the image with no name, rating, or delivery info, which reads as an incomplete component.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the tab bar height so cards scroll fully clear of the navigation, and avoid stopping the fold mid-card.

issues.description: "See all" links and the green promo banner text rely on medium-contrast green tones; the €0.90/€2.40 delivery subtitles are light gray on white, which may fall below WCAG AA for small text.
issues.suggestion: Darken secondary text and link colors to reach at least 4.5:1 contrast against their backgrounds.
